items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1962-11-01
items.q: Yeah, for Herbie Friedman. We played for them.

ctx.x: Yeah. The other one of them boys had a wife there too, you know what I mean? In that place, you know what I mean? So we played there for him. So then we played up to the school, you know, playing for the concert. Remember that concert we played?
Yeah, for Tommy Woods and Herbie Friedman. Yeah, for Herbie Friedman. We played for them.
Then after that we played several parts. We played for the ball game. The fellas of this boy had a ball club, you know? Oh, that was a fraternity. I think that was a K fraternity.
